events.factual_description: The Barnes Foundation presents First Friday: Miki Yamanaka Trio & PAAFF on Friday, November 6, 2026, from 6:00 PM to 9:00 PM, with performances at 6:30 PM and 7:45 PM. The published trio is Japanese-born, New York-based pianist Miki Yamanaka with bassist Tyrone Allen II and drummer Jimmy Macbride. The Barnes states that Allen and Macbride also perform on Yamanaka's most recent album, Breathe, released in August; Yamanaka's official Bandcamp page identifies Breathe as released August 14, 2026 and credits Allen and Macbride alongside Nicole Glover. The Barnes program is presented in partnership with the Philadelphia Asian American Film Foundation during its annual festival, running November 5–15, and First Friday admission includes access to the Barnes collection and Noguchi to Asawa: Designing Postwar America. The Barnes lists general admission at $35; National, Patron, and Contributor members and students at $10; and Supporters and Sustainers free. Seating is limited.

en.why_it_matters: This is more than another Miki Yamanaka trio date: her current working rhythm section from Breathe lands inside PAAFF's annual festival while the Barnes is showing Noguchi to Asawa, placing a Japanese-born New York jazz voice in a wider Asian American cultural frame. The trio itself is compact and contemporary—Yamanaka's piano language with Tyrone Allen II and Jimmy Macbride gives the evening a clear instrumental identity without requiring an inflated rarity claim.
en.trip_verdict: Attend if convenient in Philadelphia, especially if the PAAFF screenings or Noguchi to Asawa also matter to you. From the DMV, I would not build a dedicated regional trip around the trio alone, but it is a strong addition to an already-planned Philadelphia evening.
en.listen_before: Breathe is the useful orientation: Allen and Macbride are the rhythm section on the record, and the Barnes specifically connects this trio to that recent album.

es.why_it_matters: No es otra fecha cualquiera del trío de Miki Yamanaka: su sección rítmica actual de Breathe aparece dentro del festival anual de PAAFF mientras el Barnes presenta Noguchi to Asawa, colocando a una pianista nacida en Japón y formada en la escena neoyorquina dentro de un marco cultural asiático-americano mucho más amplio. El trío además tiene una identidad instrumental clara y contemporánea con Tyrone Allen II y Jimmy Macbride, sin necesidad de inventarle una rareza que la fecha no tiene.
es.trip_verdict: La aprovecharía si ya estás en Filadelfia, sobre todo si también te interesan las proyecciones de PAAFF o Noguchi to Asawa. Desde el DMV no armaría un viaje regional dedicado sólo al trío, pero sí suma mucho a una noche de Philadelphia que ya esté en el calendario.
es.listen_before: Breathe es la escucha útil: Allen y Macbride forman la sección rítmica del disco y el propio Barnes conecta este trío con ese álbum reciente.
